h: 上善若水：为什么「利他不生息」的人，在 AI 时代反而赚得最多？
p: 老子说「水善利万物而不争」，多数人只引半句。本文还原《道德经》第八章全文与王弼、苏辙注解：七个「善」全是能力不是品德，「不争」的完整语境是「不争位置」而非「不做事」。2026 年的数据说这是最强商业模式：独立开发者把开源做成获客渠道（32K stars、600 万下载、MRR 14.5 万美元、公司仍是一人），而「被 AI 批量生产的东西都在贬值，必须靠人、时间和真实交付积累的都在升值」。

h: 联合你的同学开一家公司：AI 时代，「四人四出资」到底能成吗？
p: 有钱的出钱、有管理能力的出管理、有技术的出技术、有圈子的出资源——这句话在 2026 年第一次真正算得过来，因为 AI 把最贵的执行一环压到了接近零。本文逐一算账：钱最不稀缺、管理能力最被高估、技术能力要重新定义、圈子最被低估。结论是「一个半」：1 个全职 + 半个人，其余当资产授权而非入股。

h: 狡兔三窟：AI 时代，一个人的公司该有几个窟？
p: 冯谖给孟尝君凿的三窟，一窟是民心（烧债券买来的义）、一窟是相位（去梁国造出的外部拉力）、一窟是宗庙（制度性保护）——三窟性质不同、互不替代，顺序不能反。2026 年 AI 把凿窟成本打到接近零，但也带来新的坑：三窟同质化。附「洞系数」自查表与三窟诊断三步。

h: The Water Principle: Why 'Benefiting Others Without Competing' Wins Most in the AI Era
p: Laozi said water benefits all things without competing, but most people quote only half the line. This piece restores the full Chapter 8 with Wang Bi's and Su Zhe's commentaries: the seven 'shans' are all capabilities rather than virtues, and 'not competing' means not fighting for position rather than not working. The 2026 data says this is the strongest business model: an indie developer turned open source into a customer-acquisition channel (32K stars, 6M downloads, $145K MRR, still a one-person company) — because anything AI can mass-produce is depreciating, while what requires people, time and real delivery is appreciating.

h: Starting a Company With Your Classmates: Does 'Four People, Four Contributions' Actually Work in the AI Era?
p: Money from one, management from another, tech from a third, connections from a fourth — this finally adds up in 2026, because AI has driven the most expensive part, execution, close to zero. This piece prices each contribution: money is least scarce (open source cut startup cost to one laptop), management capability is the most overrated (agents are taking over the execution inside management), technical skill must be redefined (judging AI boundaries and fallbacks is what is scarce), and connections are the most underrated because distribution was never flattened.

h: Three Burrows: How Many Should a One-Person Company Have in the AI Era?
p: Feng Xuan dug three burrows for Lord Mengchang: one of popular sentiment (bought by burning the debt bonds), one of external position (manufactured by touring Wei), one of institutional protection (the ancestral temple). The three are different in nature, cannot substitute for each other, and must be dug in that order. AI has made digging them nearly free — but it also created a new trap: three burrows of the same kind, which is really just one.
